world.title: Putin's party wins again as expected. So why does Russia still hold elections?
world.summary: Russians participated in elections, leading to a predictable victory for President Putin's party, United Russia. The results were not surprising, raising questions about the purpose of holding elections in a system where outcomes are largely predetermined. Analysts suggest that these elections serve to maintain a facade of democratic legitimacy, despite widespread concerns about the electoral process and opposition suppression.

world.title: Easter Sunday blasts case: Sri Lankan court sentences each convict to 220 years in prison; all 15 to appeal against verdict
world.summary: A Sri Lankan court has sentenced 15 individuals to 220 years in prison each for their roles in the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings. The convicts, found guilty of terrorism-related charges, plan to appeal the verdict, according to a defense lawyer. The sentences are among the longest ever imposed in Sri Lanka for such offenses.

world.title: Who holds the leverage? Five cards Trump and Xi bring to the table
world.summary: Donald Trump and Xi Jinping's upcoming meeting is expected to influence the future of US-China relations. While the handshake will be brief, the discussions that follow may reveal significant bargaining positions. Both leaders hold strategic leverage that could impact their countries' rivalry. The outcomes of their negotiations may shape global dynamics in the coming years.

business.title: Ema raises $77M as AI starts eating into enterprise software and services
business.summary: Ema, a startup leveraging AI agents to automate corporate processes in HR, IT, and finance, has raised $77 million in its latest funding round. This brings its total funding to $140 million. Ema currently serves over 50 enterprise customers, including major companies like Google and Microsoft, as it seeks to expand its role in enterprise software and services.

business.title: India's richest in 2026: Adani tops the list, 27 new billionaires emerge
business.summary: India's billionaire count has risen to 391, with 27 new billionaires emerging. Gautam Adani has regained the title of the country's richest individual, surpassing Mukesh Ambani. The growth in wealth reflects significant economic changes, as more individuals cross the $1 billion threshold. The evolving landscape highlights the competitive nature of wealth accumulation among India's elite.

business.title: India ramps up LPG production as Gulf supply disruptions threaten festive-season demand
business.summary: India is increasing its liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) production amid disruptions in Gulf supplies, which have raised concerns for festive-season demand. As the second-largest LPG importer globally, India previously relied heavily on the Persian Gulf for its supply, making it vulnerable to recent conflicts and trade challenges. The government aims to enhance domestic production to ensure availability.

technology.title: Sarvam AI launches Saaras V4 speech recognition model for multilingual voice applications
technology.summary: Sarvam AI has launched the Saaras V4 speech recognition model, designed for multilingual voice applications. This new automatic speech recognition (ASR) model supports five output modes and accommodates 22 Indian languages. Additionally, it features low-latency streaming capabilities, enhancing its performance for real-time applications. The launch aims to improve accessibility and usability in various tech and startup sectors.

technology.title: gen Xbox chips reportedly taped out, Kepler claims 40 TFLOPS for PS6 and 56 for Helix
technology.summary: KeplerL2 reports that Sony and Microsoft have completed the tape-out for the chips of their upcoming consoles, PlayStation 6 and Xbox Helix. The estimated GPU performance is 40 TFLOPS for the PS6 and 56 TFLOPS for the Xbox Helix. This development marks a significant step in the production of next-generation gaming hardware for both companies.

technology.title: Leaker Claims Xbox Helix Beats PS6 by 40% in TFLOPS on Paper, but Pricing May Decide the Real Winner
technology.summary: A leaker, Kepler_L2, claims the Xbox Helix outperforms the PS6 by 40% in TFLOPS on paper, with both consoles reportedly set for a late 2027 launch. The rumor has an 80% assessment rating, indicating strong evidence. However, pricing strategies may ultimately determine which console emerges as the preferred choice among consumers.

sports.title: 'Like we did in the Asia Cup': Pakistan to put India 'under pressure' in Asian Games, says Mike Hesson
sports.summary: Pakistan head coach Mike Hesson acknowledged on Wednesday that his team needs to improve to effectively challenge India at the Asian Games. He emphasized the importance of putting India "under pressure," similar to their approach in the Asia Cup. Hesson's comments reflect the team's recognition of the competitive gap they must close to succeed against their rivals.

sports.title: Roshibina Devi secures silver in wushu at Asian Games 2026
sports.summary: Indian wushu athlete Roshibina Devi secured a place in the women’s 60kg Sanda final at the 2026 Asian Games after defeating Indonesia’s Thania Kusumaningtyas 2-0 in the semi-finals. This victory guarantees India at least a silver medal, matching the country’s best-ever performance in wushu at the Asian Games. The final will determine the gold medalist.

sports.title: Asian Games 2026 Day 6: Full September 24 schedule, IST timings and Indians in action
sports.summary: On Day 6 of the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, Indian athletes will compete in 14 disciplines, including athletics, shooting, artistic gymnastics, and rowing. The schedule for September 24 outlines various events featuring Indian participants. The ongoing campaign highlights India's involvement in multiple medal events as they aim for success in this prestigious multi-sport competition.

health.title: What makes endometriosis painful? Yale researchers have a clue
health.summary: Yale School of Medicine researchers studied biopsies from 19 endometriosis patients, discovering a molecular difference in tissues that may explain varying pain levels. Some patients experience severe pain, while others report no discomfort. This finding could enhance understanding of endometriosis and lead to improved treatment options for those suffering from debilitating symptoms associated with the condition.

health.title: In a first, scientists have made brainstem cells in a petri dish
health.summary: Scientists at Stanford University have successfully created brainstem cells in a petri dish, marking a significant advancement in neuroscience. Published in Nature Neuroscience, the research explores the development of various brain regions and whether they originate from a single family of cells or involve multiple sources. This breakthrough could enhance understanding of brain complexity and development.

health.title: IMA and Abbott push for adult flu vaccination
health.summary: The Indian Medical Association (IMA) has partnered with Abbott to promote annual flu vaccination among adults during Indian Immunization Week, running from September 21 to 27. This initiative aims to raise awareness about the significance of flu vaccinations and address concerning gaps in adult immunization rates. The campaign highlights the need for increased vaccination efforts in India.

science.title: Cambridge Researchers Look Inside Living Antarctic Cells for First Time
science.summary: Engineers have developed the first microscope capable of imaging living cells in sub-zero conditions, enabling the study of Antarctic fish. This breakthrough allows scientists to capture high-resolution images of these cells for the first time, revealing insights into their survival mechanisms in extreme environments. The technology opens new avenues for research in cell biology and environmental science.

science.title: New AI tool predicts hydrogen positions to speed up drug discovery
science.summary: Researchers at New York University have developed an AI tool that predicts hydrogen atom positions in drug-like molecules. This model learns chemical patterns linked to molecular stability, enhancing the drug discovery process. The findings, published in the journal Chemistry, aim to streamline the identification of effective drug candidates by improving the accuracy of hydrogen placement in chemical structures.

science.title: Clinical documentation quality in routine care with AI scribe support: a large‑scale Spanish analysis
science.summary: A study in a large Spanish healthcare network evaluated the impact of an AI-assisted scribe system on outpatient clinical documentation quality. Analyzing over 2.3 million consultations, results showed significant improvements in semantic agreement (89.3%), readability, and structured quality scores. Manual audits indicated enhanced documentation of past medical history and allergies, supporting better patient outcomes and efficient resource use.

entertainment.title: Samay Raina’s 'India’s Got Latent 2' faces fresh controversy as complaint targets Mukesh Chhabra and OTT platform over alleged inappropriate language
entertainment.summary: Samay Raina’s comedy show 'India’s Got Latent 2' is facing controversy following a complaint against casting director Mukesh Chhabra and Netflix India. The complaint alleges the use of inappropriate language in a recent episode. This scrutiny adds to the ongoing discussions about content standards on streaming platforms and the responsibilities of creators in managing language and themes.

entertainment.title: Will Virat Kohli appear on Rohit Sharma’s TV show?
entertainment.summary: Virat Kohli has been invited to appear on Rohit Sharma's television show, 'Family Full House with Rohit Sharma,' which premiered on September 19 at 9:30 PM on Sony Entertainment Television and Sony LIV. The possibility of Kohli's appearance remains uncertain, and further details about his participation have not been disclosed. Fans are eager to know if he will join.

entertainment.title: 'I literally couldn't step out of the house for four days': 'Lust Stories 3' star Radhika Apte opens up about trauma of leaked intimate scene as people around her began seeing, discussing the clip, re
entertainment.summary: Radhika Apte discussed the emotional impact of a leaked intimate scene from her film, revealing it caused her significant distress. She described feeling unable to leave her home for four days as the clip circulated and was discussed by those around her. Apte emphasized the personal nature of such leaks, highlighting their potential to affect one's private life.
